name: Enterprise SSO Sign-In Success
summary: A user enters through an enterprise-managed single sign-on trust relationship, authenticates with the organization's identity provider under customer-controlled identity policy, resolves to the appropriate durable user and organization context, and enters an authenticated application session.
finalOutcome: The enterprise identity has been validated through the configured trust relationship, the appropriate durable application identity and organization context are resolved, and an authenticated session is active.

sourceReferences.note: Enterprise SSO is intentionally framed before implementation exists. It is a distinct business behavior from user-selected external-provider sign-in even when both eventually use OIDC underneath.
